a: तिलः — [तिल्-क] 1 The sesamum plant; नासाभ्येति तिलप्रसूनपदवीं Gīt. 10. --2 The seed of this plant; नाकस्माच्छांडिलीमाता विक्रीणाति तिलैस्तिलान् . लुंचितानितरैर्येन कार्यमत्र भविष्यति .. Pt. 2. 65. --3 A mole, spot. --4 A small particle, as much as a sesamumseed; तिले तालं पश्यति ‘makes mountains of molehills’. --Comp. --अन्नं rice with sesamum seed. --अंबु, --उदकं water with sesamum seed offered to the dead as a libation; Ś. 3; Ms. 3. 223. --उत्तमा N. of an Apsaras. --ओदनः, --नं a dish of milk, rice and sesamum. --कल्कः dough made of ground sesamum. ˚जः oil-cake made of the sediment of ground sesamum. --कालकः {1} a mole, a dark spot under the skin. {2} a disease of the penis in which the fleshy parts become black and die off. --किट्टं, --खलिः f., --खली, --चूर्णं the caky sediment of sesamum after the oil is extracted. --तंडुलकं an embrace (so called because in it the two bodies are united together like rice mixed up with sesamum-seed). --तैलं sesamum-oil. --धेनुः f. sesamum made up in the form of a cow and offered as a present to a Brāhmaṇa. --पर्णः turpentine. --(र्णं) sandal-wood. --पर्णी {1} the sandal tree. {2} frankincense. {3} turpentine. --पर्णिका, --पर्णि(र्ण)कं sandal-wood. --पिंजः, --पेजः barren sesamum. --पीडः an oilman. --भाविनी jasmine. --रसः, --स्नेहः sesamum oil. --होमः a burnt offering of sesamum.

m: तिलक m. (g. स्थूलादि) Clerodendrum phlomoides (Symplocos racemosa, L.), MBh. &c.
a freckle (compared to a sesamum-seed), VarBṛS. l, 9; lii, 10; Kathās.

(in music) N. of a Dhruvaka
a kind of horse, L.

तिलक m. (n., Pañcad. ii, 57) a mark on the forehead (made with coloured earths, sandal-wood, or unguents, either as an ornament or a sectarial distinction), Yājñ. i, 293; MBh. iii, 11591; R. (ifc. f(आ). , iii) &c.
तिलक m. the ornament of anything (in comp.), Pañcat. i, 1, 92; Kathās. &c. (ifc. f(आ). , Rājat. iii, 375)
तिलक n. id., L.
the right lung, L.
black sochal salt, L.
alliteration, Rājat.
a metre of 4 × 6 syllables
= त्रि-श्लोकी, L.
a kind of observance, Kālanirṇ. Introd. 12
a: तिलकः — [तिल्-क्वुन्, तिल इवार्थे स्वल्पे वा कन् वा] 1 A species of tree with beautiful flowers; आक्रांता तिलकक्रियापि तिलकैर्लीनद्विरेफांजनैः M. 3. 5; न खलु शोभयति स्म वनस्थलीं न तिलकस्तिलकः प्रमदामिव R. 9. 41. --2 A freckle or natural mark under the skin. --3 The sesamum tree. --कः, --कं 1 A mark made with sandalwood or unguents &c.; मुखे मधुश्रीस्तिलकं प्रकाश्य Ku. 3. 30; कस्तूरिकातिलकमालि विधाय सायं Bv. 2. 4: 1. 121. --2 The ornament of anything (used at the end of comp. in the sense of ‘best’, ‘chief’ or ‘distinguished’); जीवलोक˚ Māl. 9. 21; Pt. 1. 105. --3 The burden of a song (ध्रुवक). --का A kind of necklace. --कं 1 The bladder. --2 The lungs. --3 A kind of salt. --4 A kind of disease, the appearance of dark spots on the skin without any inflammation. --5 Alliteration. --Comp. --आश्रयः the forehead.

k.v: तिलकः क्षुरकः श्रीमान्समौ पिचुलझावुकौ। श्रीपर्णिका कुमुदिका कुम्भी कैटर्यकट्फलौ॥
वलिरः केकरे खोडे खञ्जस्त्रिषु जरावराः। जडुलः कालकः पिप्लुस्तिलकस्तिलकालकः॥
पश्चाद्ग्रीवाशिरा मन्या नाडी तु धमनिः शिरा। तिलकं क्लोम मस्तिष्कं गोर्दं किट्टं मलोऽस्त्रियाम्.।
तमालपत्रतिलकचित्रकाणि विशेषकम्. द्वितीयं च तुरीयं च न स्त्रियामथ कुङ्कुमम्.।
सौवर्चलेऽक्षरुचके तिलकं तत्र मेचके। मत्स्यण्डी फाणितं खण्डविकारः शर्करा सिता॥

yaTA, -- “doze maRqalasaMsTAne maRqalAnIva paSyati । dviDEkaM dfzwimaDyasTe bahuGA bahuDAsTite ॥ dfzweraByantaragate hrasvavfdDaviparyyayam । nAntikasTamaDaHsaMsTe dUragaM noparisTitam ॥ pArSve paSyenna pArSvasTe timirAKyo'yamAmayaH । prApnoti kAcatAM doze tftIyapawalASrite ॥ tenordDamIkzate nADastanucelAvftopamam । yaTA varRaYca rajyeta dfzwirhIyeta ca kramAt ॥ taTApyupekzamARasya caturTaM pawalaM gataH । liNganASaM malaH kurvvan CAdayeddfzwimaRqalam ॥ tatra vAtena timire vyAvidDamiva paSyati । calAvilAruRABAsaM prasannaYcekzate muhuH ॥ jAlAni keSAn maSakAn raSmIMScopekzite 'tra ca । kAcIBUte dfgaruRA paSyatyAsyamanAsikam ॥ candradIpAdyanekatvaM vakramfjvapi manyate । vfdDaH kAco dfSaM kuryyAdrajoDUmAvftAmiva ॥ spazwAruRABAM vistIrRAM sUkzmAM vA hatadarSanAm । saliNganASo vAte tu saNkocayati dfkSirAH ॥ dfNmaRqalaM viSatyantargamBIrAdfgasO smftA । pittaje timire vidyut KadyotadyotadIpitam ॥ SiKitittiripicCABaM prAyo nIlaYca paSyati । kAce dfkkAcanIlABA tAdfgeva ca paSyati ॥ arkenduparivezAgnimarIcIndraDanuMzi ca । BfNganIlA nirAlokA dfksnigDA liNganASataH ॥ dfzwiH pittena hrasvAKyA sA hrasvA hrasvadarSanA । Bavet pittavidagDAKyA pItA pItABadarSanA ॥ kaPena timire prAyaH snigDaM SvetaYca paSyati । SaNKendUkundakusumEH kumudEriva cAcitam ॥ kAce tu nizpraBendvarka pradIpAdyErivAcitam । sitABA sA ca dfzwiH syAlliNganASe tu lakzyate ॥ mUrttaH kaPo dfzwigataH snigDo darSananASanaH । bindUrjalasyeva calaH padminIpuwasaMsTitaH ॥ uzRe saNkocamAyAti CAyAyAM parisarpati । SaNKakundendUkumudasPawikopamaSuklimA ॥ raktena timire raktaM tamoBUtaYca paSyati । kAcena raktA kfzRA vA dfzwistAdfk ca paSyati ॥ liNganASe'pi tAdfkdfNnizpraBA hatadarSanA । saMsargasannipAtezu vidyAt saNkIrRalakzaRAn ॥ timirAdInakasmAcca tEH syAdbyaktAkulekzaRam । timiMre SezayordfzwO citro rAgaH prajAyate ॥” iti vABawenottarasTAne dbAdaSe'DyAye uktam ॥ asya cikitsA yaTA, -- “timira kAcatAM yAti kAco'pyAnDyamupekzayA । netrarogezvato GoraM timiraM sADayeddrutam ॥ tulAM paceta jIvantyA droRe'pAM pAdaSezitEH । tatkvATe dviguRaM kzIraM GftaprasTaM vipAcayet ॥ prapORqarIkakAkolI pippalI loDrasEnDavEH । SatAhvA maGukadrAkzA sitAdAruPalatrayEH ॥ kArzikErniSi tat pItaM timirApaharaM param ॥” “pawolanimbakawukA dArvvIsevyavarAvfzam । saDanvayAsatrAyantI parpawaM pAlikaM pfTak ॥ prasTamAmalakAnAYca kvATayennalvaRe'mBasi । tadAQake'rdDapalikEH pizwEH prasTaM GftAt pacet ॥ mustaBUnimbazazwyAhvakuwajodIcyacandanEH । sapippalIkEstatsarpirGrARakarRAsyarogajit ॥ vidraDijvaraduzwArurvisarpApacikuzWanut । viSezAcCukratimiranaktAnDyozRAmladAhanut ॥” “triMSadBAgA BujaNgasya ganDapAzARapaYcakam । SulvatAlakayordvO dvO vaNgasyEko'YjanAtrayam ॥ anDamUzIkftaM DmAtaM pakvaM vimalamaYjanam । timirAntakaraM loke dvitIya iva BAskaraH ॥ gomUtre Cagalarase'mlakAYjike ca strIstanye havizi vize ca mAkzike ca । yattutTaM jvalitamanekaSo niziktaM tatkuryyAt garuqasamaM narasya cakzuH ॥” “rasendraBujagO tulyO tayostulyamaTAYjanam । Izat karpUrasaMyuktamaYjanaM nayanAmftam ॥” “sAmAnyaM sADanamidaM pratidozamataH SfRu । vAtaje timire tatra daSamUlAmBasA Gftam ॥ kzIre caturguRe SrezWAkalkapakvaM pibettataH ॥” “pittaje timire sarpirjIvanIyaPalatrayEH । vipAcitaM pAyayitvA snigDasya vyaDayecCirAm ॥ SlezmodBave'mftAkvATavarAkaRaSftaM Gftam । viDyecCirAM pItavato dadyAccAnuvirecanam ॥” “raktaje pittavatsidDiH SItEScAsraM prasAdayet .” “dadyAduSIraniryyUhacUrRitaM kaRasEnDavam ॥ tat SftaM saGftaM BUyaH pacet kzOdraM Gane pibet । SIte cAsmin hitamidaM sarvvaje timire'Yjanam ॥” “cakzUrakzAyAM sarvvakAlaM manuzyEryatnaH karttavyo jIvite yAvadicCA । vyarTo loko'yaM tulyarAtrindivAnAM puMsAmanDAnAM vidyamAne'pi vitte ॥” iti cottarasTAne trayodaSe'DyAye vABawenoktam ॥ “sOvIramaYjanantutTantApyo DAturmmanaHSilA । cakzuzyaM maDukaM lohA maRayaH pOzyamaYjanam ॥ sEnDavaM SOkarIdaMzwrA katakaYcAYjanaM SuBam । timirAdizu cUrRaM vA varttirvveyamanuttamA ॥” “vadane kfzRasarpasya nihitaM mAsamaYjanam । tatastasmAt samudDftya saSuzkaM cUrRayedbuDaH ॥ sumanaHkzArakEH SuzkErardDAMSEH sEnDavena ca । etannityAYjanaM kAryyaM timiraGnamanuttamam ॥” iti carake cikitsAsTAne 26 aDyAye ॥)

puM, (timyati klidyati cakzuranena । tima + “izimadimudIti .” uRAM । 1 । 52 । iti kirac .) cakzUrogaviSezaH । tasya nidAnAdi yaTA । caturTapawalagatadozamAha । “timirAKyaH sa yo dozaScaturTapawalaM gataH । ruRadDi sarvvato dfzwiM liNganASa iti kvacit ॥ asminnapi tamoBUte nAtirUQe mahAgade । candrAdityO sa nakzatrAvantarIkze ca vidyataH ॥ nirmmalAni ca tejAMsi BrAjizRUni ca paSyati । sa eva liNganASastu nIlikAkAcasaMjYitaH ॥ yo dozaH dozo'tra rogaH caturTapawalaM vAhyapawalaM gataH sa timirAKyaH । timiradarSanena timiramasyAstIti timiraH arSa AditvAt । tasya lakzaRamAha ruRadDItyAdi । sa timirAKyaH । sarvvataH sarvvatra । liNganASa iti kvacit tantrAntare liNganASasaMjYaH । tasya niruktiSca । liNgyate cihnyate aneneti liNgaM dfzwitejaH tasya nASo'smin iti liNganASaH । asminnapi timire'pi tamoBUte tamastulye । atra tu BUtaSabdastulyArTaH । BUtaM prARyatIte same trizvityamaravacanAt । nAtirUQe aprOQe । candrAdityO nakzatrARi ca paSyati । antarIkze antarIkzasya prakASamayatvena tamo'BiBAvAt । tejAMsi agnyAdeH । BrAjizRUni ratnasuvarRAdIni । asmin prOQe nIraje ca candrAdityAdInna paSyatItyanvayaH । nIlikAkAcasaMjYitaH nIlikAkAceti nAmAntarAByAM yuktaH ॥ * ॥ dfzwirogARAM saNKyAnAmAni cAha । dfzwyASrayA zaw ca zaqeva rogAH zaqliNganASA hi Bavanti tatra । vAtena pittena kaPena sarvvEruktAt parimlAyya viDiSca zazWaH ॥ dfzwyASrayA zaw ca zaqeva rogAH zaw zaw dbAdaSetyarTaH । tatra liNganASAH zaw tAn vivfRoti vAtenetyAdi ॥ * ॥ taTA naraH pittavidagDadfzwiH kaPena cAnyastvaTa DUmadarSI । yo hrasvajAtyo nakulAnDyasaMjYo gamBIrasaMjYA ca taTEva dfzwiH ॥ pittavidagDadfzwyAdayaH zaw । evaM dfzwyAdayaSca zaw । evaM dfzwyASrayA dvAdaSarogAH ॥ * ॥ tatra dvAvanyO cAha । tatrEvAnyO gadO badDO sanimittAnimittakO ॥ tezu vAtajasya liNganASasya lakzaRamAha । vAtena Kalu rUpARi BramantIva ca paSyati । AvilAnyaruRABAni vyAvidDAnIva mAnavaH ॥ AvilAni kaluzARi । aruRAni avyaktalOhityayuktAni । AvidDAnIva kuwilAnIva ॥ * pEttikamAha । pittenAdityaKadyotaSakracApataqidguRAn । nftyataScEva SiKinaH sarvvaM nIlaYca paSyati ॥ AdityAdInAM guRAn rUpARi ॥ * ॥ SlEzmikamAha । kaPena paSyedrUpARi snigDAni ca sitAni ca । salilaplAvitAnIva jAlakAnIva mAnavaH ॥ * ॥ sannipAtajamAha । sannipAtena citrARi viparItAni paSyati । bahuDApi dviGA vApi sarvvARyeva samantataH ॥ hInADikA sAnyaTA vA jyotIMzyapi ca paSyati ॥ citrARi nAnAvarRAni । viparItAni vEparItyaM vivfRoti bahuDetyAdi ॥ * ॥ raktajamAha । paSyedraktena raktAni tamAMsi viviDAni ca । haritAnyaTa kfzRAni pItASvapi ca mAnavaH ॥ * ॥ parimlAyinamAha । raktena mUrcCitaM pittaM parimlAyinamAcaret । tena pItA diSaH paSyedudyantamiva BAskaram ॥ vikIryyamARAn KadyotErvfkzAMstejAMsi cEva hi ॥ vikIryyamARAn vyApyamAnAn agnyAdiBiriva ॥ vAtAdijanitErnetravarRErapi sa zaqviDaH । liNganASo nigadito varRo vAtAdito yaTA ॥ rAgAruRo mArutataH pradizwo mlAyI ca nIlaSca taTEva pittAt । kaPAt sitaH SoRitataH saraktaH samastadozapraBavo vicitraH ॥ * ॥ vAtAdinA hetuBUtena janite netravizaye maRqale rUpaviSezamAha । aruRaM maRqalaM vAtAccaYcalaM paruzaM taTA । pittato maRqalaM nIlaM kAMsyABaM vA sapItakam ॥ SvetaM pItaM vA kaTametat vyADipraBAvAt ॥ SlezmaRA bahalaM snigDaM SaNKakundendupARqaram । calatpadmapalASasTaSuklo bindurivAmBasaH । mfdyamAne tu nayane maRqalaM tadbisarpati ॥ bahalaM sTUlam । maRqalaM tu BaveccitraM liNganASe tridozaje । pravAlapadmapatrABaM maRqalaM SoRitAtmakam ॥ citraM vAtAdivarRam । raktajaM maRqalaM dfzwO sTUlakAcAruRapraBam । parimlAyini roge syAt mlAnaM nIlamaTApi vA ॥ dozakzayAt svayaM tatra kadAcit syAttu darSanam ॥ raktajaM pittAnugAmiraktajam । sTUlakAcAruRapraBaM sTUlakAcasyevAruRA praBA yasya tat । etena sTOlyamaruRatvaYca boDyate । dozakzayAdityAdi । tatra parimlAyini kAlAntareRa dozakzayAt kadAcit svayameva darSanaM syAt ॥ * ॥ anuktavyaTAdAhagOravAdidozaliNga-saMgrahaRArTamAha । yaTAsvaM dozaliNgAni sarvvezveva Bavanti hi ॥ * ॥ pattavidagDadfzwerlakzaRamAha । pittena duzwena gatena dfzwiM pItA Bavedyasya narasya dfzwiH । pItAni rUpARi ca tena paSyet sarvvo naraH pittavidagDadfzwiH ॥ pittena gatena dfzwiM dfzwAvapi praTamadbitIye pawale gateneti bodDavyam । tena vyADinA ॥ * ॥ tasminneva pitte dfzwO tftIyaM pawalaM gate rUpaviSezamAha । prApte tftIyaM pawalaM tu doze divA na paSyenniSi vIkzate saH । rAtrO sa SItAnugfhItadfzwiH pittAlpaBAvAt sakalAni paSyet ॥ doze'tra pitte ॥ * ॥ aTa SlezmavidagDadfzwilakzaRamAha । taTA naraH SlezmavidagDadfzwistAnyeva SuklAni hi manyate tu । atrApi SlezmaRo dfzwO praTamadvitIyapawalagatasyEtalliNgaM bodDavyam ॥ * ॥ sa eva SlezmA dfzwO pawalatrayaM gato naktAnDyaM karotItyAha । tripu sTito yaH pawalezu dozo naktAnDyamApAdayati prasahya । divA sa sUryyAnugfhItadfzwiH paSyettu rUpARi kaPAlpaBAvAt ॥ dozo'tra kaPastasyopakrAntatvAt । naktAnDyasya SlezmavidagDadfzwAvantarBUtatvAcca pfTaggaRanA ॥ * ॥ DUmadarSinamAha । SokajvarAyAH saSiro'BitApEravyAhatA yasya narasya dfzwiH । DUmrAMstu yaH paSyati sarvvaBAvAt sa DUmadarSIti naraH pradizwaH ॥ Siro'BitApaH Sirasi GarmmAdinA santApaH । etasya pittadozo bodDavyaH ॥ * ॥ hnasvajAtyamAha । yo vAsare paSyati kazwato'Ta rUpaM mahaccApi nirIkzate'lpam । rAtrO punaryaH prakftAni paSyet sa hnasvajAtyo muniBiH pradizwaH ॥ * ॥ nakulAnDyamAha । vidyotate yasya narasya dfzwirdozABipannA nakulasya yadvat । citrARi rUpARi divA sa paSyet sa vE vikAro nakulAnDyasaMjYaH ॥ * ॥ gamBIrakamAha । dfzwirvvirUpA SvasanopasfzwA saNkucya yAByantarataH prayAti । rujAvagAQA ca tamakzirogaM gamBIraketi pravadanti tajjYAH ॥ virUpA vikftA । SvasanopasfzwA vAtopahatA । rujAvagAQA gamBIravedanAnvitA ॥ * ॥ vAhyO punardvAvapi saMpradizwO nimittataScApyanimittataSca । nimittatastasya Siro'BitApAt jYeyastvaBizyandanidarSanEH saH ॥ vAhyO suSrutoktadbAdaSasaMKyeByo'DikO tatra nimittata Aha Siro'BitApAt Siro'BitApyate yena vizakusumaganDavahapavanasparSena sa Siro'BitApastasmAt । aBizyandanidarSanEH raktABizyandaliNgEriti gadADaraH ॥ sannipAtABizyandaliNgEriti kArttikaH ॥ * ॥ animittata Aha । surarziganDarvvamahoragARAM sandarSanenApi ca BAskarasya । hanyeta dfzwirmmanujasya tasya sa liNganASastvanimittasaMjYaH ॥ anupalaByamAnAnAM surAdInAM darSananimittamapyanimittaM manyate ॥ * ॥ animittato liNganASasya lakzaRamAha । tatrAkzivispazwamivAvaBAti zEdUryyavarRA vimalA ca dfzwiH । vispazwaM jyotiryuktam । vEdUryyavarRA SyAmA vimalA nirmmalA । iti dfzwirogAH ॥ * ॥ aTa timiracikitsA । “BuktvA pARitalaM GfzwvA cakzuzoryadi dIyate । acireREva tadvAri timirARi vyapohati ॥ * ॥ SaNKanABirviBItasya paTyAmajjA manaHSilA । pipyalI maricaM kuzWaM vacA ceti samAMSakam ॥ CAgIkzIreRa saMpizya vawIM kuryyAdyavonmitAm । hareRumAtrAM saMGfzya jalenAYjanamAcaret ॥ timiraM mAMsavfdDiYca kAcaM pawalamarvvudam । rAtryanDaM vArzikaM puzpaM vawI candrodayA haret ॥” iti candrodayA vawI ॥ * ॥ kaRA salavaRozaRA saharasAYjanA sAYjanA saritpatikaPaH sitA sitapunarnnavA samBavA । rajanyaruRacandanaM maDu ca tutTapaTyASilA arizwadalasAvarasPuwikaSaNKanABIndavaH ॥ imAni tu vicUrRayenniviqavAsasA SoDayettaTAyasi vimarddayet samaDutAmraKaRqena tat । idaM muniBirIritaM nayanaSoRanAmAYjanaM karoti timirakzayaM pawalapuzpanASaM balAt ॥ lavaRaM sEnDavam । aYjanaM suramA iti loke । saritpatikaPaH samudraPenaH । SilA manaHSilA । sAvaro loDraH । sPuwikaH PawkarI । indUH karpUraH । nayanaSoRaM timire nUtanakusume nUtanapawale ca ॥ * ॥ harItakI vacA kuzWaM pippalI maricAni ca । viBItakasya majjA ca SaNKanABirmmanaHSilA ॥ sarvvametat samaM kftvA gavyakzIreRa pezayet । nASayettimiraM kaRquM pawalARyarvvudAni ca ॥ api trEvArzikaM SukraM mAsenEkena nASayet । aDikAni ca mAMsAni rAtrAvanDatvameva ca ॥ candrodayA vawI puzpe timire ca ॥ * ॥ rajanI nimbapatrARi pippalI maricAni ca । viqaNgaM BadramustaYca saptamI tvaBayA smftA ॥ ajAmUtreRa saMpizya CAyAyAM SozayedbawIm । vAriRA timiraM hanti gomUtreRa tu pizwikAm ॥ maDunA pawalaM hanti nArIkzIreRa puzpakam । ezA candrapraBAvarttiH svayaM rudreRa nirmmitA ॥ iti candrapraBAvarttiH ॥ * ॥ kaRA CAgayakfnmaDye pakvA tadrasapezitA । acirAdDanti naktAnDyaM tadbat sakzOdramUzaRam ॥ triPalAyA rasaM prasTaM prasTaM BfNgarajasya ca । vfzasya ca rasaM prasTaM SatAvaryyASca tatsamam ॥ guqUcyA AmalakyASca rasaM CAgIpayastaTA । prasTaM prasTaM samAhftya sarvvEreBirGftaM pacet ॥ kalkaH kaRA sitA drAkzA triPalA nIlamutpalam । maDukaM kzIrakAkolI maDuparRI nidigDikA ॥ tatsADusidDaM vijYAya SuBe BARqe niDApayet । UrdDvaM pAnamaDaHpAnaM maDye pAnaM praSasyate ॥ yAvanto netrajA rogAstAn pAnAdapakarzati । surakte raktaduzwe ca rakte vA viSrute taTA ॥ naktAnDye timire kAce nIlikA pawalArvvude । aBizyande'DimanTe ca yakzmakope sudAruRe ॥ netrarogezu sarvvezu dozatrayakftezvapi । paraM hitamidaM proktaM triPalAdyaM mahAGftam ॥ BfNgarajaH BfNgarAjaH BaNgagarA iti loke । kzIrakAkolyA alABe aSvaganDAmUlaM grAhyam ॥ maDuparRyatra jalajaM yazwImaDu cakzuzyatvAt । tadalABe sAmAnyaM yazwImaDu grAhyaM tUlyaguRatvAt ॥ triPalAdyaM Gftam ॥ * ॥ SatamekaM harItakyA dviguRaYca viBItakam । caturguRaM tvAmalakaM vfzamArkavayoH samam ॥ caturguRodakaM dattvA SanErmmfdvagninA pacet । BAgaM caturTaM saMrakzya kvATaM tamavatArayet ॥ SarkarA maDukaM drAkzA maDuyazwirnnidigDikA । kAkolI kzIrakAkolI triPalA nAgakeSaram ॥ pippalI candanaM mustaM trAyamARAmaTotpalam । GftaprasTasamaM kzIraM kalkEretEH SanEH pacet ॥ hanyAt satimiraM kAcaM naktAnDyaM Sukrameva ca । taTA srAvaYca kaRqUYca SvayaTuYca kazAyatAm ॥ kaluzatvaYca netrasya viDarmmapawalAnvitam । bahunAtra kimuktena sarvvAn netrAmayAn haret ॥ yasya copahatA dfzwiH sUryyAgniByAM prapaSyataH । tasyEtadBezajaM proktaM muniBiH paramaM hitam ॥ mArjjitaM darpaRaM yadvat parAM nirmmalatAM vrajet । tadvadetena pItena netraM nirmmalatAmiyAt ॥ vAridroRadvayaM cAtra vfzamArkavayostule । kAkolIyugalAlABe aSvaganDAmUlaM grAhyam ॥ dvitIyaM triPalAdyaM Gftam ॥ * ॥ netrarogADikAraH .” iti BAvaprakASaH ॥ * ॥ kiYca । gAruqe 198 aDyAye । “katakasya PalaM SaNKaM sEnDavaM tryuzaRaM vacA । Peno rasAYjanaM kzOdraM viqaNgAni manaHSilA ॥ ezAM varttirhanti kAsaM timiraM v: pu॰ tiryyak sroto AhArasaYcAro yasya । paSupakzyAdO tezAmaSitAnnasya tiryyaktayA udare saYcArAt taTAtvam । tadBedABAga॰ । 3 । 10 । 21 “tiraScAmazwamaH sargaH so'zwAviMSadviDomataH । avido BUritamaso GrARajYA hfdyavedinaH । gOrajo mahizaH kfzRaH SUkaro gavayoruruH । dviSaPAH paSavaSceme aviruzwraSca sattama! । Karo'Svo'Svataro gOraH SaraBaScamarI taTA । ete cEkaSaPAH kzatteH! SfRu paYcanaKAn paSUn । SvA SfgAlo vfko vyADro mArjjAraH SaSaSallakO । siMhaH kapirgajaH kUrmmo goDA ca makarAdayaH । kaNkagfDra vakaSyenaBAsaBallUkavarhiRaH । haMsasArasacakrANgakAkolUkAdayaH KagAH .” “tiryyaksrotasAM sargamAha tiraScAmiti । sa cAzwAviMSatiBedaH । tiraScAM lakzaRam avidaH SvastanAdijYAnaSUnyAH । BUritamasaH AhArAdimAtranizWAH । GrARajYAH GrARenEvezwamarTaM jAnanti hfdi avedinaH dIrGAnusanDAnaSUnyAH । taTA ca SrutiH “aTetarezAM paSUnAm aSanApi pAse evABivijYAnaM na vijYAtaM vadanti na vijYAtaM paSyanti na viduH SvastanaM na lokAlokAviti” । azwAviMSatiBedAnAha gavAdaya uzwrAntAH dviSaPAH dviKurA nava gavAdayaH camaryyantA ekaSaPAH zaw । SvAdayo goDAntAH paYcanaKAdvAdaSa । evamete BUcarAH saptaviMSatiH, BakarAdayo jalacarAH kaNkAdayaSca KagAH । aBUcaratvenEkIkftya gfhItAH । tadevamazwAviMSatiBedAn vadanti । tezu kfzRarurugOrAH mfgaviSezAH anyezAmapi tiryyake prARinAmetezveba yaTAyaTamantarBAvaH .”
